title: Genome-wide knockout screen of OC43/SARS-CoV2-infected Vero E6 cells
model: Vero E6 cells, custom Vervet genome-wide knockout library, SARS-CoV-2 / OC43 survival selection
contrast: Infected vs uninfected Day-0 library (SARS-CoV-2 4 vs 3; OC43 single 4 vs 3)
paper_method: MAGeCK a-RRA, positively selected genes (Additional files 4 and 5)
paper_calls: TP53, CDKN1A, ACE2, RAD54L2 (SARS-CoV-2); TMEM41B, SLC35B2, EXT1, IFITM (OC43)
barcs_calls: SARS-CoV-2: 1,614 genes at FDR 0.10 (median-ratio totals); OC43: 22 enriched (depletion uninterpretable, totals capped)
named_hits: SARS-CoV-2 CDKN1A #1, TP53 #2, ACE2 #7, rank corr 0.77; OC43 IFITM1/3 #1, TMEM41B #3, SLC35B2 #12
verdict: BARCS reproduces the authors' top SARS-CoV-2 hits (CDKN1A, TP53, ACE2) and OC43 hits (IFITM, TMEM41B) with rank correlation 0.77; the post-selection bottleneck means only enrichment is interpretable and OC43 depletion is not.
